name: response-branches
purpose: Pages through alternative versions of one assistant response or one edited prompt: after Try again, after the reader edits a prompt, or when the model returned several candidates, the message shows one version at a time with a `‹ 2/3 ›` pager under it, or alone in the message's action row when no slot is given. The owner keeps every version and renders the active one in the default slot; the component owns only the position and the pager. It is the AI Elements `Branch` pattern, rebuilt on Azion UI's `IconButton` and tokens.
useWhen: Use ResponseBranches to page through alternative versions of one AI response; rows of a table or list use Pagination.
A response was regenerated and the earlier versions stay available to compare.
A model returned several candidates and the person picks the one to keep reading.
avoidWhen: Pages of one long list → use `Pagination`.
Different documents side by side → use `Tabs`.
related: `chat-message` — the message whose body the branches wrap; its actions hold Regenerate.
`streaming-response` — a new version streams in the slot while the pager already counts it.
bestPractices: Move to the new version when Regenerate finishes (set `v-model` to the last index) so the person sees what they asked for.
Keep the versions in the order they were made; the newest is last.
Do not render the pager inside the slot; it belongs to the component so its position and labels stay the same across versions.

props.name: count
props.doc: How many versions exist. With one or none the pager is not drawn.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the pager group. Empty uses the locale catalog (`Response versions`).

props.name: disabled
props.doc: Locks the pager, for example while a new version streams.

slots.name: default
slots.notes: Optional. The active version. Rendered once; the owner switches its content by `index`. Left out, only the pager renders, as in `ChatMessage.Actions`' `#leading` slot.
